Buyer Information
Terms & Conditions
Full policy details

Lead Time

In-stock styles: shipped within 8 business days after payment confirmation, subject to availability at time of order. Made-to-order styles: 25 to 35 business days. As all pieces are handmade, this timeframe may extend depending on the quantity ordered.

Included with First Order

Digital brand kit: lookbook + product descriptions. Each piece ships with a dustbag, branded paper box.

Order Cancellation

Once the deposit is confirmed and production has started, the order is non-cancellable and non-refundable. Changes to style, color, or quantity are only accepted prior to production start.

Exchange Policy & Price Validity

Pricing and availability

All RRP (Recommended Retail Price) prices are listed in EUR and subject to change with prior notice. Orders are subject to product availability.

Payment methods

Bank wire transfer and payment link (all major credit cards): contabilidad@bibianahernandez.com

Returns and exchanges

All wholesale sales are final, except in the case of confirmed manufacturing defects. Defects must be reported within 10 business days of delivery by emailing contacto@bibianahernandez.com or via WhatsApp at +57 316 774 8495, including photos and a description of the defect.

Warranty

90 calendar days from purchase for manufacturing defects. To file a claim, email contacto@bibianahernandez.com with photos, a description of the defect, and proof of purchase. Please also review our full warranty policy at bibianahernandez.com/pages/terminos-y-condiciones.

Resale price & confidentiality

The buyer agrees to honor the Recommended Retail Price (RRP) and not to offer products below this price point, including on unauthorized marketplaces.
